name: seat-reduce
title: Seat Reduce
description: Seat-reduction flow that asks who goes, suggests unaccepted invites then least-active members (never owners or admins), warns when you pick an admin or someone active today, and shows the new bill, when it starts and what happens to each person's work.

meta.stops: Fewer seats locked out an active admin
meta.summary: Makes lowering a seat count an explicit choice of who loses access, with the new bill and what happens to their work.
meta.server: Recheck seats, roles and billing server-side; never let a client choice remove the last owner or admin.
catches: More members than the new seat count, until you choose who goes
Unaccepted invites suggested first, then least-active plain members
Picking an admin, owner or someone active today
New bill and when it starts
What happens to each removed person's work
limits: Activity and work summaries come from the props you pass
Does not change billing; onConfirm receives the seats and who goes
a11y: Section labelled by its title; member checkboxes have <label>s
Seat count input has an aria-label; arrow keys change it and +/- buttons have aria-labels
Selection status and warnings render in polite live regions
Bill highlight animation skipped under reduced motion
